notes.title: Patch with Korean language is here!
notes.notes:
Hello Cosmic Players,

We are coming back to you with the new update. It brings one major change to our Korean Symmetrians - full subtitles in the native language of this beautiful peninsula. It doesn't end there though, as we managed to implement other improvements for everyone:

Notification when one of the characters has a low life level,
Information about the main goal for the player at the end of the intro,
New names of the difficulty levels.

Let us know in the comment section what you think about the changes and be brave on your next deadly mission ;)

Take care,
IMGN.PRO and Sleepless Clinic Team
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26658614/34df512a19ca911afa604afd8cbd34131a7b734f.jpg

notes.title: Patch for ultrawide monitors is here!
notes.notes:
Hello fellow Symmetrians,

Following one of the most often requests from our amazing community, we decided to prepare official support for the ultrawide monitors. From now on, you can enjoy playing SYMMETRY in all glorious 21:9 resolutions. The UI was adjusted to your screens and should no longer be an issue, but please let us know if the game displays properly now on your hardware.

Take care,
IMGN.PRO and Sleepless Clinic Team

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 is live now!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26658614/7ba7132a0223751521e64eb37c6cb68daa922550.png
Hello Symmetrians,

At the start, we wanted to thank you all for the fantastic support you have shown to us in the last 48 hours. As some of you requested, we were working hard on introducing a new, lower difficulty level, and we are coming back to you with the patch 1.0.1! From now on you will be able to learn the game mechanics without the excessive stress thanks to the new, Normal level.

Additionally, we have fixed some minor bugs which you reported to us from the time of the game premiere. We can't wait to read your feedback, so let us know what you think about this update :)

Best of luck!
IMGN.PRO and Sleepless Clinic Team

notes.title: SYMMETRY gets an official release date and new trailer!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26658614/e5a6f9470d92dac70c4708eac0e610f43b2102cf.png
Hello fellow Symmetrians,

We are proud to announce that SYMMETRY is launching on Steam (PC & Mac), PlayStation®4 and Xbox One on February 20, 2018! The waiting time seemed to be long, but we used it wisely to provide the best experience possible. 

Without spoiling the fun, Dariusz Leczycki, co-owner of our studio has a special message to all the players:

“As a survival management game, SYMMETRY’s storyline will propel you forward toward big payoffs depending upon the strategies employed across the survivors,”
“At first look, SYMMETRY is basic, old school looking game, but don’t be fooled, it is complex, compelling, and most of all, fun, and possesses a storyline that you don’t see coming.”

Also, to mark this fantastic occasion, we prepared a new trailer. Enjoy watching it and leave us some feedback in the comments section:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=NWV22Vbi4eg&feature=youtu.be
Take care!
Sleepless Clinic Team
